tagline: Integrated power generation and retail electricity provider serving essential power resources across the U.S.
hero_kpi_rationale: VST has signed 20-year PPA agreements with Meta (2,609 MW) and AWS (1,200 MW) to supply carbon-free nuclear energy to cloud data centers, reflecting the structural growth in energy demand driven by cloud and AI operations.

kpis.short: Contrats long-terme avec Meta et AWS
kpis.name: Carbon-free power contracted (Meta + AWS)
kpis.explanation: Total power contracted through 20-year PPA agreements with Meta and Amazon Web Services to power cloud data centers.
kpis.description: VST has entered into 20-year PPAs with Meta (2,609 MW from PJM nuclear plants, delivery from late 2026 to late 2027) and AWS (1,200 MW from Comanche Peak, delivery from Q4 2027 to 2032).
kpis.signal: Demonstrates VST's strategic position to support data and AI growth.

kpis.name: Total generation capacity
kpis.explanation: Total electricity generation capacity of the company, measured in megawatts.
kpis.description: VST's total generation capacity is 44,000 MW, sourced from a diversified portfolio including natural gas, nuclear, coal, solar, and battery storage.
kpis.signal: Indicates the scale and scope of energy production operations.

kpis.name: Retail customer count
kpis.explanation: Total number of residential, commercial, and industrial customers served by the company.
kpis.description: VST serves approximately 5 million retail electricity and natural gas customers across 16 U.S. states and the District of Columbia.
kpis.signal: Indicates the reach of the company's retail market footprint.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Spending dedicated to the acquisition or improvement of long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: Capex is used to develop new facilities (860 MW in West Texas), upgrade existing facilities, and maintain generation capacity.
kpis.signal: Reflects investment in capacity expansion and modernization.

kpis.name: Credit rating (Moody's)
kpis.explanation: Investment-grade credit rating assigned by rating agencies.
kpis.description: In December 2025, S&P upgraded Vistra's credit rating to BBB- (investment grade) from BB+ previously, reflecting improved financial profile.
kpis.signal: Improved credit quality and access to capital markets.

kpis.name: Dividends paid to shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total amount of dividends paid to common shareholders during the year.
kpis.description: Vistra paid $306 million in dividends to common shareholders in 2025.
kpis.signal: Direct return to shareholders and indication of strong cash flow.

kpis.name: Vistra share repurchases
kpis.explanation: Total amount of common shares repurchased by the company.
kpis.description: Vistra repurchased 6.6 million shares for approximately $1 billion in 2025. The cumulative program has repurchased 167 million shares for $5.9 billion since 2021, with $1.8 billion of remaining authorization.
kpis.signal: Return to shareholders and indication of management confidence in valuation.

kpis.name: Meta PPA Agreement: 2,609 MW of nuclear energy
kpis.explanation: 20-year PPA signed in January 2026 with Meta Platforms to supply carbon-free nuclear energy from PJM plants.
kpis.description: VST entered into a 20-year PPA with Meta to supply 2,609 MW of carbon-free power and capacity from its Perry, Davis-Besse, and Beaver Valley nuclear plants in PJM, with phased delivery from late 2026 to late 2034.
kpis.signal: Demonstrates ability to meet sustainable energy needs of cloud and AI giants.

kpis.name: AWS PPA Agreement: 1,200 MW from Comanche Peak
kpis.explanation: 20-year PPA signed in September 2025 with Amazon Web Services to supply 1,200 MW of carbon-free power from Comanche Peak nuclear plant.
kpis.description: VST entered into a 20-year PPA with Amazon Web Services to supply 1,200 MW of carbon-free power from its Comanche Peak nuclear plant, with delivery starting Q4 2027 and full capacity by 2032.
kpis.signal: Highlights VST's strategic role in supporting AWS's sustainability and data growth objectives.

kpis.name: Cogentrix Acquisition: 5,500 MW natural gas
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Cogentrix Energy comprising 10 natural gas generation facilities totaling 5,500 MW of capacity.
kpis.description: VST signed definitive agreements in December 2025 to acquire Cogentrix Energy, including 10 modern natural gas facilities (CCGT and CT) totaling 5,500 MW across PJM, ISO-NE, and ERCOT. Closing expected mid-to-late 2026.
kpis.signal: Significant and diversified expansion of natural gas generation capacity across multiple ISO regions.

kpis.name: Lotus Acquisition: 2,600 MW natural gas
kpis.explanation: Acquisition completed in October 2025 of 7 natural gas facilities totaling 2,600 MW across PJM, ISO-NE, NYISO, and CAISO.
kpis.description: Vistra acquired 100% of the interests in Lotus subsidiaries in October 2025, adding 7 natural gas facilities totaling 2,600 MW in Delaware, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, New York, and California for a base price of $1.9 billion.
kpis.signal: Significant geographic diversification of natural gas portfolio and multi-regional expansion.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company identifies cybersecurity as a significant risk with regular oversight by the Sustainability and Risk Committee, training for directors, and appointment in 2023 of a director with cybersecurity expertise

risks.title: Regulatory
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a regulated environment including FERC, ERCOT, ISO-NE, NYISO, CAISO, and stringent environmental regulations

risks.title: Supply chain and labor shortages
risks.score_rationale: The industry faces persistent supply chain constraints, labor shortages, extended lead times, and rising labor costs

risks.title: Geopolitical risks (Russian uranium)
risks.score_rationale: The Russia-Ukraine conflict and the PRUI Act create uncertainty around uranium supply. Russia temporarily suspended shipments in November 2024

risks.title: Nuclear plant operational risks
risks.score_rationale: Nuclear plant safety and operational reliability are critical; any incident would have significant impacts on production and reputation

risks.title: Competition in electricity retail
risks.score_rationale: Electricity retail is a competitive market with multiple suppliers; VST competes on price, customer service, and innovative offerings

risks.title: Energy transition and asset devaluation
risks.score_rationale: The portfolio includes coal assets (Coleto Creek, Miami Fort) and there is regulatory/market risk of asset devaluation

ai_positioning.summary: Vistra Corp. does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. However, the growth in long-term contracts with Meta and AWS indirectly reflects positioning in the cloud and data infrastructure supporting AI applications.
evidence: PPA agreements with Meta and AWS to power cloud data centers (infrastructure for AI)
